# Vendored MD4C

Unmodified `src/md4c.c`, `src/md4c.h` and `LICENSE.md` from
https://github.com/mity/md4c/tree/release-0.5.2 (MD4C 0.5.2).

MIT license; reproduced in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES` for binary distributions.
Only the parser is compiled, directly alongside Capstan's sources. No HTML
renderer, shared library or build-time download is required.

Capstan's ncurses-independent renderer lives in `src/markdown.c`.
